sections.heading: SECTION B IDENTIFYING GROUP AND CLASSIFICATION

pictures.what: two small black paw prints (animal footprints)
outline of a hooked bird beak

blocks.notes: Left column is pictures, right column a. webbed feet / b. beak of a bird / c. footprint of an animal. Numerals sit at the bottom-left of each picture: paw prints above 'i.', webbed foot between 'i.' and 'ii', beak above 'iii.' — read as i=paw prints, ii=webbed foot, iii=beak (each picture ends at its numeral). 'ii' printed without a full stop. Intended key i-c, ii-a, iii-b.

(ii) 'An insect with three pairs of legs and one antennae' — factually/grammatically off (insects have one pair of antennae; 'antennae' is plural); any insect is a defensible answer (open) ⚑. (iii) veins. (iv) intended 'web of life' (textbook game name) — wording loose ⚑. (v) owl. Items (ii) and (iv) lack a closing full stop; others have one.

(i) answer Pachmarhi (textbook: 'got ready for a nature trail at Pachmarhi'); question wording 'Where did the students get ready to go' is odd but answerable. (ii) open (two rules). (iv) printed 'How do  leaves' with double space. (ii)-(v) judgement ⚑.
Two blanks per item, likely 0.5 per name. Printed 'Name  two' with double space. All five are open-list answers; (i) 'Common birds seen around you' is personal. ⚑ all 5.
